articles.body: Is it or not possible to purchase local alliances and deploy if there is no Commander ? This question because Commanders are not officeholders and the rule page 14 ( no candidates or hirers ) seems to apply only to officeholders.
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>Is it or not possible to purchase local alliances and deploy if there is no Commander ? This question because Commanders are not officeholders and the rule page 14 ( no candidates or hirers ) seems to apply only to officeholders.</safehtml></xml>

articles.body: I guess my question would be who would make the decision to purchase those local alliances and deploy if there's no commander? The president seems like the choice, but I don't think that's stated anywhere.

articles.body:
Yeah if there's no commander, you can't deploy or hire alliances.

The only thing an army can do without a commander is exhaust pieces for defense. (Military Affairs does it, and if that's empty then the Chairman. Rules p33.)
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>Yeah if there's no commander, you can't deploy or hire alliances.<br/><br/>The only thing an army can do without a commander is exhaust pieces for defense. (Military Affairs does it, and if that's empty then the Chairman. Rules p33.)</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
Can't deploy in the Presidents' phases. 

Can defend vs invasion/rebellion in the Events in India phase.
